fields.name: Item
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2E2E340 (DropEntityRequestSystem, per dropped entity) writes elem+0 = *puVar22, the 8-byte handle of the entity being dropped (the request's item); Toolkit esv::pickup::PickUpSplitRequestSystem::Update reads its stack amount. Element named by the game esv::inventory_transfer::SplitRequest (Toolkit IndexedStorage assert).

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2E2E340 copies 16 bytes (4 dwords) from the validator's result (vtable slot +8 of the request validator at system+0x68) into elem+8..+0x18; the Toolkit compares this value with ls::operator==(Guid) against action-resource spend events. Meaning not established.

fields.name: Amount
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2E2E340 writes elem+0x18 = (int) of the request's second qword (the amount of the drop request, an ls::Optional<int> in the Toolkit's pick-up path), 4 bytes.

fields.name: _Pad1C
fields.evidence: Never written by bg3.exe+0x2E2E340; element stride 0x20 (bg3.exe+0x13C7560 copies 0x20-byte elements).

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2E2EE70 (DropEntityRequestSystem, reads the singleton by storage index DAT_146392d44) sets its size (+0xC) to 0 and appends the frame's requests with bg3.exe+0x13C7560 (stride 0x20, plain 32-byte copies); the elements are built in bg3.exe+0x2E2E340. Creator bg3.exe+0x2E2F820 allocates 0x10 and zeroes pointer/capacity/size. Live (seen.py, idle): empty.

open_questions: What the 16-byte value at +8 identifies (the Toolkit treats it as a Guid).
second_pass: Offsets and widths read in bg3.exe: the builder bg3.exe+0x2E2E340 writes +0 (8 bytes), +8 (16 bytes) and +0x18 (4 bytes) of each 0x20-byte element, and bg3.exe+0x2E2EE70/0x13C7560 copy the frame's elements into the singleton's array; only the meaning of +8 stays open.
live_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
